It comes in through fast-glob and micromatch, which next-pwa calls only inside its webpack hook during next build, with glob patterns written in its own code and in next.config.mjs. No request or user file reaches it, and next-pwa is not part of the server functions or the browser bundle. See docs/security/dependencies.md.

Every zod 3 release is affected and the fix is zod 4.6.6, a major upgrade that touches the AI output schemas (KRB-241). zod 3 still checks every item of an array over its max, with one error each: a 2 MB request of a million items took 284 MB. The two server actions that get arrays from the browser, reorderSections and markNotificationsRead, now refuse a list over their limit before zod runs (KRB-240). Other request input reaches zod as strings and fixed objects; the FedaPay webhook checks its signature first. See docs/security/dependencies.md.
